# Kucozone MC Server: 回归本真
您也可以在[哐哐造官网](https://docs.qq.com/aio/p/sc6ken4k226ox47?p=3jtzbHJ9MMPYALCdIsh5KM&nlc=1)查看更多内容。
![Beta1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8233aa2f4d68ebc1de9432977162f3ecc6ef138_0.webp)
## Core Philosophy​
Welcome to "Kuangkangzao" – an exclusive Minecraft world crafted for adventurers who love pure survival. We firmly believe in the core charm of vanilla gameplay, rejecting redundant mods that dilute the essence of the game. Only lightweight configurations that substantially optimize the survival experience are retained, ensuring every exploration stays true to Minecraft's most authentic form.​

## Free Exploration Gameplay​
You can cast off cumbersome rules and embark on an unrestrained adventure:​
Step into the unknown forest at dawn, collect the first piece of wood, and build your initial shelter​
Light a torch at dusk to fend off zombies and skeletons​
Dive into deep mines and feel the excitement of exploration in the glow of diamonds and redstone​
Board a ship across the ocean to find underwater temples and sunken ship treasures hidden in the deep sea​
From digging soil with bare hands to building grand structures, from surviving alone to establishing a home – every step of growth is forged by your own hands.​

## Diverse Social Experience​
This is not only a haven for enjoying solitude but also a paradise for gathering with friends:​
Invite a few friends to reclaim farmland and build a shared base, experiencing the joy of collaboration through division of labor​
Team up to challenge the Ender Dragon and Wither, creating passionate memories in side-by-side battles​
Gather around the campfire in your spare time to share loot, freezing your unique Minecraft moments in laughter​

##Sincere Invitation​
We look forward to every player who loves survival and enjoys creation joining "Kuangkangzao". Here, you can not only gain the tranquility and sense of achievement from solo exploration but also embrace the warmth and joy of being with friends, together writing your legendary story in the blocky world.​

我们期待每一位热爱生存、享受创造的玩家加入 “哐哐造”，在这里既能收获独自探索的宁静与成就感，也能拥抱与好友相伴的温暖与欢乐，一同书写属于你们的方块世界传奇。​加入QQ群聊【提比帕斯】981697922 立即游玩
